original_test_intent: Run NVIDIA NVQual storage stress Tests #18 and #36 against only the approved disposable SSD targets and prove every required item completes without unacceptable device, controller, data or platform degradation.
original_method: An authorized operator pins the licensed NVQual build and test manifests, maps immutable drive identities through the storage stack, removes all protected targets, approves data destruction, runs the vendor workflow under health/thermal/power monitoring, preserves per-item results and performs post-stress integrity checks.
manual_activity: The owner designates disposable drives and approves data loss; an authorized operator verifies physical/logical identities, stages the isolated storage topology, launches the pinned Tests #18/#36 and reviews all outcomes before reuse.
required_inputs: NVQual package/version/hash/license and authoritative Test #18/#36 documents
Resolved item manifests and exact vendor launcher/target-selection syntax
Target serial/WWN/NGUID/EUI64, bay, controller/BDF and stable OS path mapping
Proof each target is disposable and not boot/OS/EFI/swap/mounted/LVM/RAID/device-mapper/unknown
Backup, data-destruction and post-test sanitize/re-provision approvals
I/O pattern, destructive scope, duration, capacity range, workers, queue depth and limits
Baseline/post NVMe SMART/vendor health, media/error counters and integrity method
safety_requirements: Never select a drive from a mutable /dev name alone
Fail closed if any target identity or storage-stack membership is ambiguous
Do not touch system, boot, EFI, swap, mounted, LVM, RAID, device-mapper, production or unknown storage
Require explicit owner approval for destructive data disposition and exact targets
Preserve kernel/BMC/controller/NVMe evidence and monitor thermals/power continuously
Stop on wrong target, I/O/media error, controller reset, PCIe fault, RAID degradation, data-integrity warning, thermal/power breach or lost console; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify package/manifest and immutable target identities
Build a fail-closed allowlist and compare it immediately before launch
Monitor and parse per-item output plus device health when authorized
Perform no target selection by guess, destructive I/O, format/sanitize, reset, retry or verdict without approval
engineer_actions: Supply licensed package and exact Tests #18/#36 manifests/commands
Approve immutable disposable targets and data-destruction/recovery plan
Define I/O parameters, limits, denominator and exception policy
Review raw item and post-integrity evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL PACKAGE-GATED DESTRUCTIVE STORAGE QUALIFICATION WITH FAIL-CLOSED TARGET IDENTITY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the resolved NVQual items to immutable drive identifiers and a full storage-stack exclusion proof, freeze that run manifest, then execute under controller/NVMe/thermal monitoring and verify data/device integrity afterward.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds precise target identity, excluded-device proof, data authorization, workload parameters, safety monitoring and recovery without weakening vendor coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A suite summary or generic storage health check cannot replace individual Test #18/#36 results or demonstrate that the correct drives were stressed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Device paths can renumber after reset and RAID/multipath can obscure physical membership. Rechecking serial/NGUID plus controller and stack membership immediately before launch is necessary to prevent catastrophic selection of a boot or production drive.

project_override_considerations: Any unsupported item or non-disposable target remains BLOCKED for execution and outside the pass numerator; substituting a non-destructive workload requires separate coverage approval and cannot silently satisfy destructive vendor tests.
expected_evidence: NVQual/Test #18/#36 package, license, document and resolved-manifest hashes
Immutable approved target mapping and complete protected-storage exclusion proof
Owner data-destruction/backup/recovery approval and exact I/O parameter manifest
Per-item stdout/stderr, exit codes, timings, I/O/media/controller/PCIe/thermal/power evidence
Post-test identity/SMART/vendor health/integrity, denominator, no-wrong-target/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require NVQual storage Tests #18/#36 with all items passed. Missing package, target and destructive-I/O details are readiness dependencies rather than conflicting source statements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose is identifiable and execution is possible after licensed package, immutable disposable targets and destructive-data approval are supplied. Static review is complete without choosing a target.

review_improvement: Adds fail-closed drive identity, full protected-storage exclusion, data authorization and post-stress integrity to the original package-gated destructive warning.
independent_technical_reasoning: Storage stress can remain apparently successful while acting on the wrong physical device because Linux paths, multipath aliases and RAID membership are mutable. The safety contract must resolve serial/NGUID through controller and stack membership immediately before launch, then retain the same mapping in every result. Separating Test #18 and #36 outcomes also prevents one successful item from masking a destructive failure or unsupported case in the other.
